title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star
text:
Many children know the rhyme Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star. It is a short song about a little star in the sky. The star shines at night. Children sing it in school.

The rhyme has easy words. It has a happy tune. Children like to clap and sing it together. Mother often sings it to the baby at bedtime.

options: A little star in the sky
A big dog in the park
A red car on the road

questions.text: Who often sings the rhyme to the baby?
Why are the words easy for young children?
options: They are in a different language

questions.text: Why do children probably like this rhyme?
options: It is short, happy, and fun to sing

vocabulary.definition: a short song or poem with simple words
hit your hands together to make a sound
a series of musical notes that makes a song

paragraph_translations: Muchos niños conocen la rima Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star. Es una canción corta sobre una pequeña estrella en el cielo. La estrella brilla por la noche. Los niños la cantan en la escuela.
La rima tiene palabras fáciles. Tiene una melodía alegre. A los niños les gusta aplaudir y cantarla juntos. Mamá a menudo la canta al bebé a la hora de dormir.
